scenario: LCST.4.3.1 — String->Float is fallible, so a missing '?' is a hard error. Pin: s.txt::Float (no '?') rejects with DS_VALIDATE_CAST_NULLABILITY.
rules_ds:
schema S scope logical:
    f: Float key
    txt: String mutable
    i: Int mutable

rule r:
    S s
->
    let x = s.txt::Float
    log info "x"
